content_sections.heading: CSIR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSIR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSIR Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CSIR Vacancy 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Scientist III (PS-III-AC), 1 for Project Scientist III (PS-III-ADME-PK), 1 for Project Scientist I (PS-I-BS), 1 for Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT-AC) and 1 for Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT-ADME-PK).

content_sections.heading: CSIR Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Scientist III (PS-III-AC): Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent AND 7 years experience in research & development. Area of Specialization: Analytical Chemistry/Pharmaceutical Analysis/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Life Sciences. Project Scientist III (PS-III-ADME-PK): Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent AND 7 years experience in research & development. Area of Specialization: Pharmacology/Pharmaceutical sciences/Toxicology/Life Sciences/Biotechnology. Project Scientist I (PS-I-BS): Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent AND 4 years experience in research & development. Area of Specialization: Analytical Chemistry/Pharmaceutical Analysis/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Pharmacology. Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT-AC): Masters/Integrated Masters/Bachelor's degree/Doctoral degree with 2-3 years experience. Area of Specialization: Analytical Chemistry/Organic Chemistry/Pharmacology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Life Sciences/Biotechnology. Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT-ADME-PK): Masters/Integrated Masters/Bachelor's degree/Doctoral degree with 2-3 years experience. Area of Specialization: Pharmacology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Life Sciences/Biotechnology.

content_sections.heading: CSIR Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable: Upper age limit relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST, Divyangjan (PWD) and female applicants; 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer). Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: CSIR Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Scientist III (PS-III-AC): Rs. 78,000/- + HRA Project Scientist III (PS-III-ADME-PK): Rs. 78,000/- + HRA Project Scientist I (PS-I-BS): Rs. 56,000/- + HRA Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT-AC): Rs. 42,000/- + HRA Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT-ADME-PK): Rs. 42,000/- + HRA

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the CSIR Project Scientist / Senior Project Associate posts is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by CSIR?
faq.answer: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Project Scientist and Senior Project Associate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for CSIR recruitment?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from a Doctoral Degree in Science or Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology to a Bachelor's degree with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CSIR Project Scientist and Senior Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, PWD, female applicants, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for CSIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist and Senior Project Associate positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 42,000/- to Rs. 78,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA), depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for the CSIR recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Mumbai, Maharashtra, at the CSIR facility. The exact address is provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these CSIR posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist / Senior Project Associate posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
